title: silene flavescens subsp. dictaea
intro: Silene flavescens subsp. dictaea, commonly known as Dictæa, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is a perennial plant traditionally used in medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene flavescens subsp. dictaea include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in treating stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and offer potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality.
